func (r *TransmuteJobRepo) ClaimRecoverableJobs(ctx context.Context) ([]TransmuteJob, error) {
	_ = r.db.WithContext(ctx).Exec(`
		UPDATE cdc_system.transmute_jobs
		   SET status = 'CANCELLED',
		       error_message = 'cancelled by user',
		       finished_at = NOW(),
		       updated_at = NOW()
		 WHERE cancel_requested = true
		   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED')
		   AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '45 seconds'
	`).Error

	var jobs []TransmuteJob
	err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Raw(`
		WITH claimed AS (
			SELECT job_id
			FROM cdc_system.transmute_jobs
			WHERE cancel_requested = false
			  AND (
			      status = 'PAUSED'
			      OR (status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '45 seconds')
			  )
			ORDER BY updated_at ASC
			LIMIT 10
			FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
		)
		UPDATE cdc_system.transmute_jobs j
		   SET updated_at = NOW()
		  FROM claimed c
		 WHERE j.job_id = c.job_id
		RETURNING j.*
	`).Scan(&jobs).Error
	return jobs, err
}
